Primary_state.Step25_conclusion: Cross-patient transcriptionally conserved and internally portable malignant state.

Primary_reference_state.Name: Hepatic-Differentiated
Primary_reference_state.Step25_conclusion: Differentiated/metabolic comparator preserved across the two patients with adequate MS6 support.

Interpretation: MS3 is retained as a cross-patient conserved and internally portable proliferative malignant-cell state. Its conserved Core50 signature reproducibly identifies MS3 in held-out patients and distinguishes it from other malignant states. MS6 remains the principal differentiated and metabolic reference. Independent external validation has not yet been performed.
Next_step: Step26 will perform deep biological characterization of the frozen MS3 state and its contrast with MS6.
